1	import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
2	
3	part 'failure.freezed.dart';
4	
5	/// AD-3 — the one closed `Failure` hierarchy, exactly 14 subtypes: the 13
6	/// codes from `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` plus the local-only
7	/// `malformedResponse` (client-side parse failure, never sent by the
8	/// backend). Never redefined or subset per feature; every repository method
9	/// returns `Either<Failure, T>` built from this type (RNF09).
10	///
11	/// `retryable` is derived here, once, from the 6 server `retryable:true`
12	/// codes (AD-4) — no other file re-decides which codes retry.
13	@freezed
14	sealed class Failure with _$Failure {
15	  const factory Failure.authExpired({required String message}) = AuthExpired;
16	  const factory Failure.authInvalid({required String message}) = AuthInvalid;
17	  const factory Failure.networkTimeout({required String message}) =
18	      NetworkTimeout;
19	  const factory Failure.networkOffline({required String message}) =
20	      NetworkOffline;
21	  const factory Failure.validation({required String message}) = Validation;
22	  const factory Failure.piiCheckFailed({required String message}) =
23	      PiiCheckFailed;
24	  const factory Failure.embeddingFailed({required String message}) =
25	      EmbeddingFailed;
26	  const factory Failure.aiGenerationTimeout({required String message}) =
27	      AiGenerationTimeout;
28	  const factory Failure.notFound({required String message}) = NotFound;
29	  const factory Failure.rateLimited({required String message}) = RateLimited;
30	  const factory Failure.exportEmptyPeriod({required String message}) =
31	      ExportEmptyPeriod;
32	  const factory Failure.payloadTooLarge({required String message}) =
33	      PayloadTooLarge;
34	  const factory Failure.ocrNoText({required String message}) = OcrNoText;
35	
36	  /// Local-only — the client's own parse-failure detection. `retryable` is
37	  /// hardcoded `false` for this subtype (AD-3).
38	  const factory Failure.malformedResponse({required String message}) =
39	      MalformedResponse;
40	
41	  const Failure._();
42	
43	  /// The 6 server `retryable:true` codes (AD-4). Every other code —
44	  /// including the local `malformedResponse` — is `false`.
45	  bool get retryable => switch (this) {
46	    NetworkTimeout() => true,
47	    NetworkOffline() => true,
48	    PiiCheckFailed() => true,
49	    EmbeddingFailed() => true,
50	    AiGenerationTimeout() => true,
51	    RateLimited() => true,
52	    AuthExpired() ||
53	    AuthInvalid() ||
54	    Validation() ||
55	    NotFound() ||
56	    ExportEmptyPeriod() ||
57	    PayloadTooLarge() ||
58	    OcrNoText() ||
59	    MalformedResponse() => false,
60	  };
61	
62	  /// Maps a backend error `code` (`error-taxonomy.md`) to its `Failure`
63	  /// subtype. An unrecognized code (should never happen — the taxonomy is
64	  /// closed) falls back to [Failure.malformedResponse] rather than throwing,
65	  /// so no repository ever lets an unmapped error escape (RNF09).
66	  factory Failure.fromCode(String code, String message) => switch (code) {
67	    'AUTH_EXPIRED' => Failure.authExpired(message: message),
68	    'AUTH_INVALID' => Failure.authInvalid(message: message),
69	    'NETWORK_TIMEOUT' => Failure.networkTimeout(message: message),
70	    'NETWORK_OFFLINE' => Failure.networkOffline(message: message),
71	    'VALIDATION_ERROR' => Failure.validation(message: message),
72	    'PII_CHECK_FAILED' => Failure.piiCheckFailed(message: message),
73	    'EMBEDDING_FAILED' => Failure.embeddingFailed(message: message),
74	    'AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT' => Failure.aiGenerationTimeout(message: message),
75	    'NOT_FOUND' => Failure.notFound(message: message),
76	    'RATE_LIMITED' => Failure.rateLimited(message: message),
77	    'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD' => Failure.exportEmptyPeriod(message: message),
78	    'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE' => Failure.payloadTooLarge(message: message),
79	    'OCR_NO_TEXT' => Failure.ocrNoText(message: message),
80	    _ => Failure.malformedResponse(message: message),
81	  };
82	}

3	/// spec-7-1/spec-7-2 — the export job's own progress, modeled as its own
4	/// sealed domain entity (AD-12: never force `status`+`narrativeStatus`
5	/// into `Resource<T>`), mirroring `BookmarkState`'s own shape: sealed,
6	/// with `const factory` constructors declared on the base class so call
7	/// sites read as `ExportJobState.preparing()` rather than naming each
8	/// subclass directly. Exactly the 6 states `docs/input/backend/export-
9	/// screen-states.md`'s own status×narrativeStatus×downloadAvailable table

12	/// wire.
13	///
14	/// Never persisted (AD-15: ephemeral, polled live) — lives only on
15	/// `ExportJobCubit.state`.
16	sealed class ExportJobState {
17	  const ExportJobState();

19	  /// `status: 'pending'` — spinner, "Preparando exportação...". Also this
20	  /// cubit's own initial state, since `export-summary-create`'s 202

24	
25	  /// `status: 'processing'` — progress bar, "Gerando resumo com IA...",
26	  /// no download of any kind yet.
27	  const factory ExportJobState.generating() = ExportJobGenerating;
28	
29	  /// `status: 'data_ready'` — spec-7-2's own state: the raw export file
30	  /// is ready to download while `narrativeStatus` is still `processing`
31	  /// underneath it. Renders the same progress-bar/text treatment as
32	  /// [ExportJobState.generating], plus the "Baixar dados brutos" button
33	  /// rendered already enabled beneath (no PDF button here — a PDF folds
34	  /// the narrative in, which isn't done yet).
35	  const factory ExportJobState.dataReady() = ExportJobDataReady;
36	
37	  /// `status: 'done'` — [outcome] distinguishes "Concluído" (narrative
38	  /// succeeded, both download buttons shown) from "Narrativa falhou/
39	  /// pulada" (only the raw-data button, copy scoped to the narrative
40	  /// failure) without needing two separate sealed variants for what is,
41	  /// to the job itself, one and the same terminal success.
42	  const factory ExportJobState.done(ExportOutcome outcome) = ExportJobDone;
43	
44	  /// `status: 'error'`, any `errorCode` other than `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` —
45	  /// generic error copy, no download, non-retryable/terminal. [failure]
46	  /// is always built via the one shared `Failure.fromCode` (AD-3) — never
47	  /// a second, ad hoc mapping of the raw `errorCode` string.

input.message:
Implemented spec-8-1 (On-Demand Dashboard Aggregation Across Entry Counts) in full, per the frozen spec.

## New `dashboard` feature (all files new)
- `lib/features/dashboard/domain/entities/dashboard_aggregate.dart` — `DashboardAggregate{totalCount, bucketCounts}`, no flutter/data import (RNF06).
- `lib/features/dashboard/domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart` — `getAggregate({required String period})`, `Either<Failure, T>` (RNF09).
- `lib/features/dashboard/data/models/dashboard_aggregate_dto.dart` (+ generated `.g.dart`) — full-contract DTOs (`DashboardSourcesDto`/`DashboardBucketDto`/`DashboardTotalsDto`/`DashboardAggregateDto`) mirroring every `openapi.yaml:1582-1688` field, plus `toDomain()`.
- `lib/features/dashboard/data/datasources/dashboard_remote_data_source.dart` — calls `dashboard-aggregate-get` via `ApiClient.get`, `queryParameters: {'period': period}`.
- `lib/features/dashboard/data/repositories/dashboard_repository_impl.dart` — thin pass-through, no cache.
- `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/cubit/dashboard_cubit.dart` — `Cubit<Resource<DashboardAggregate>>`; constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites` and calls `load()` on every event; `load()` always passes `period: 'all'`, with a generation guard against stale in-flight results.
- `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart` — renders the 4 count states (0 → icon+message; 1 → single full-height bar+message; >30 → condensed to exactly 10 bars via contiguous-chunk summing with remainder in the last chunk, regardless of `buckets.length`; 2..30 → one bar per bucket, no text) plus loading/error states. `DashboardChartBar` is a small public widget so bars are countable in tests.
- `lib/features/dashboard/dashboard_injection.dart` — `registerDashboardFeature()`, `DashboardCubit` as `registerLazySingleton` with `dispose: close()`.

## Wiring changes
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` — calls `registerDashboardFeature()` after `registerExportFeature()` (must run after `registerEntriesFeature()`, since `DashboardCubit` depends on the shared `PendingEntryWriteTracker`).
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` — `/configuracoes` now passes `sl<DashboardCubit>()` too.
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart` — widened constructor (`dashboardCubit` required); `initState` now also calls `dashboardCubit.load()` unconditionally; body restructured with `MultiBlocProvider` (toggle cubit + dashboard cubit) and wrapped in `Expanded(SingleChildScrollView(...))` so the new chart section (inserted as a sibling below the toggle) can't overflow a shorter viewport — this scroll wrapping wasn't specified in the frozen spec, decided per AGENTS.md's "decide and proceed".
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — new `// --- Dashboard (spec-8-1) ---` section with exactly the 5 tokens the Code Map named (`dashboardBarAreaHeight=100`, `dashboardBarRadius=4`, `dashboardEmptyStateGap=10`, `dashboardCardPadding=20`, `dashboardEmptyStateIconSize=28`), values read directly off `cerne-prototype.html`'s `dashEmpty`/`dashNotEmpty` blocks (confirmed by locating the actual markup inside the prototype's escaped JSON blob — color/radius/elevation/spacing all reuse existing tokens where they matched exactly: `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `colorAccent`, `colorBorder`, `spacingSm`/`spacingLg`).

## Tests
- `test/features/dashboard/data/{datasources,models,repositories}/*_test.dart` — data-source decode/error-mapping, DTO fromJson/toDomain, repository pass-through.
- `test/features/dashboard/presentation/cubit/dashboard_cubit_test.dart` — idle start, period fixed to `'all'`, success/failure emission, `confirmedWrites`-triggered recompute, generation guard against a stale in-flight call, close()-while-in-flight safety.
- `test/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section_test.dart` — all 5 I/O-matrix rows (0/1/mid-range/>30 with buckets.length both ≥10 and <10/fetch-fails), plus a "live fetch replaces stale rendering" check.
- Updated `test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart` for the widened constructor (added a fake `DashboardRepository`/`PendingEntryWriteTracker` helper).
- Updated `test/core/navigation/app_router_test.dart` and `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart` to register/resolve the new `DashboardCubit`/`DashboardRepository` so the router and real-DI-graph suites keep passing.

## Verification
- `fvm flutter pub get` — resolved cleanly.
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` — generated `dashboard_aggregate_dto.g.dart`, no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm dart format` — applied to all new/changed files (3 unrelated pre-existing files elsewhere in the repo have their own pre-existing formatting drift; left untouched, out of scope).
- `fvm flutter test` (full suite) — **1161 tests, all passing**, including the new dashboard suites and every touched existing suite (account, app_router, bootstrap_integration).

## Notable decisions (AGENTS.md "decide and proceed")
- The 2..30 "matrix gap" renders one bar per bucket with no text, per Boundaries' explicit resolution.
- `>30` condensation: first 9 chunks of `buckets.length ~/ 10` each, last chunk absorbs the remainder — produces exactly 10 bars even when `buckets.length < 10` (verified with both a 40-bucket and a 3-bucket >30-total fixture).
- Loading/idle state renders a small `CircularProgressIndicator`; error state reuses the exact same inline-error text style (`textBodyMd` + `colorError`) the biometric toggle already uses — neither is in the frozen I/O matrix, both are minor, undocumented gaps.
- `AccountSettingsScreen` gained a scrollable wrapper (not explicitly asked for) to keep the now-taller screen safe from overflow on shorter devices/larger text scale — functionally inert on anything that already fit.

Nothing left incomplete. The narrative paragraph, period selector, and any caching were deliberately never implemented, per the spec's "Never" line and AD-15.

message.content:
The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
Code review of your spec-8-1 implementation found one real defect plus several smaller gaps. The spec file (_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-8-1-on-demand-dashboard-aggregation-across-entry-counts.md) has already been amended (see its Boundaries bullet on condensation and its new "Spec Change Log" section) — re-read it before making changes. Apply these patches:

1. **Condensation bug (the main fix, confirmed by review, root-caused to the spec's own original wording — now amended)**: in `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart`'s `_condense`, when `bucketCounts.length < 10` the floor-division chunk size is 0, so the first 9 output chunks all sum an empty range (0) and the 10th chunk absorbs the entire total — renders as 9 invisible bars + 1 giant bar. Fix: left-pad `bucketCounts` with leading zero-count entries up to length 10 (only when shorter) before running the existing chunking logic. Add/strengthen a test proving a small-bucket-count case (e.g. 3 buckets, total > 30) produces a non-degenerate distribution (leading zero bars, then the real data at the end) — not just a bar-count assertion.

2. **Defensive guard**: in the same file's `_populatedCard`, if the computed `barCounts` would end up empty (e.g. `totalCount > 0` but `aggregate.bucketCounts` is empty — malformed/inconsistent backend data), fall back to rendering a single bar for the whole `totalCount` rather than silently rendering an empty bar row.

3. **Boundary test**: add explicit tests pinning `totalCount == 30` (renders one bar per bucket, no condensation) vs `totalCount == 31` (condenses to 10) — the off-by-one boundary of the `>30` rule is currently untested.

4. **Accessibility**: `DashboardChartSection` never announces an error to screen readers, unlike the biometric toggle section right above it on the same screen (which calls `_announce` in `AccountSettingsScreen`). 128	  Widget _populatedCard(DashboardAggregate aggregate) {
129	    final totalCount = aggregate.totalCount;
130	    if (totalCount == 0) {

132	    }

206	  /// Boundaries (amended, Spec Change Log): "`bucketCounts` left-padded
207	  /// with leading zero-count entries to length 10 (when shorter) *before*
208	  /// condensing... via 10 contiguous index chunks, summed `count`,
209	  /// remainder in the last chunk". The original, frozen wording degenerated
210	  /// whenever `bucketCounts.length < _targetCondensedBars`: the floor-
211	  /// division chunk size was `0`, so the first 9 chunks each summed an
212	  /// *empty* range (always `0`) and the 10th silently absorbed the entire
213	  /// total — 9 invisible bars + 1 giant one, defeating the chart for any
214	  /// user whose activity concentrates into fewer than 10 distinct backend
215	  /// buckets while still exceeding 30 entries. [_pad] below removes that
216	  /// degeneracy: once [bucketCounts] is at least [_targetCondensedBars]
217	  /// long (real data, or zero-padded), the same "first 9 chunks of
218	  /// `length ~/ 10`, 10th absorbs the remainder" chunking produces a
219	  /// non-degenerate spread — leading zero bars, then the real data at the
220	  /// end, for a short [bucketCounts]. Always exactly [_targetCondensedBars]
221	  /// ints out, regardless of `bucketCounts.length` (I/O matrix: "`>30`
222	  /// entries, any `buckets.length`").
223	  static List<int> _condense(List<int> bucketCounts) {
224	    final padded = _pad(bucketCounts);
225	    final chunkSize = padded.length ~/ _targetCondensedBars;
226	    final condensed = <int>[];
227	    var index = 0;
228	    for (var i = 0; i < _targetCondensedBars - 1; i++) {
229	      final end = index + chunkSize;
230	      condensed.add(_sum(padded, index, end));
231	      index = end;
232	    }
233	    condensed.add(_sum(padded, index, padded.length));
234	    return condensed;
235	  }

237	  /// Left-pads [bucketCounts] with leading zero-count entries up to
238	  /// [_targetCondensedBars] — a no-op once [bucketCounts] already has at
239	  /// least that many entries (Boundaries: "when shorter").
240	  static List<int> _pad(List<int> bucketCounts) {
241	    if (bucketCounts.length >= _targetCondensedBars) {
242	      return bucketCounts;
243	    }
244	    return [
245	      ...List<int>.filled(_targetCondensedBars - bucketCounts.length, 0),
246	      ...bucketCounts,
247	    ];
248	  }
249	
250	  static int _sum(List<int> list, int start, int end) {
251	    var total = 0;
252	    for (var i = start; i < end; i++) {
253	      total += list[i];
254	    }
255	    return total;
256	  }

Applied all 7 round-2 review patches to the spec-8-1 dashboard implementation, re-read the amended spec first (its Boundaries line and new Spec Change Log section covering the left-pad fix).

## Changes

**1. Condensation bug (main fix)** — `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart`: added a `_pad()` helper that left-pads `bucketCounts` with leading zero-count entries to length 10 (only when shorter) before `_condense()`'s existing chunking logic runs. This fixes the degenerate case where `bucketCounts.length < 10` made the floor-division chunk size 0, collapsing the chart into 9 invisible bars + 1 giant bar. Strengthened the existing "well under 10" test in `dashboard_chart_section_test.dart` to assert the actual per-bar `heightFraction` distribution (7 leading zero-height bars, then 3 full-height bars) instead of just a bar count.

**2. Defensive guard** — `_populatedCard` now falls back to a single bar for the whole `totalCount` when the computed `barCounts` would otherwise be empty (contract-inconsistent/malformed backend data). New test: `totalCount: 5, bucketCounts: []` → exactly 1 bar at full height.

**3. Boundary tests** — added explicit tests pinning `totalCount == 30` (5 bars, no condensation) vs `totalCount == 31` (10 bars, condensed).

**4. Accessibility** — empty-state icon now carries a `semanticLabel`; the bar row is wrapped in one summarizing `Semantics` label with the individual bars excluded from the semantics tree (`ExcludeSemantics`); `AccountSettingsScreen` now wraps `DashboardChartSection` in a `BlocListener<DashboardCubit, Resource<DashboardAggregate>>` that calls its existing `_announce` method on `ResourceError`, mirroring how the biometric toggle's own error is already announced. Added `find.bySemanticsLabel` assertions to cover both.

**5. Visual smoothness** — loading/error cards switched from `DesignTokens.spacingLg` (24px) to `DesignTokens.dashboardCardPadding` (20px), matching the populated card's padding so the card no longer visibly resizes on loading→data transitions. Empty-state card padding left at `spacingLg` (grounded directly in the prototype's `dashEmpty` block), per the instruction.

**6. Verification gap** — added a test to `test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart` that configures a `_FakeDashboardRepository.getAggregateResult` to a non-default value (`totalCount: 5`) *before* pumping the real `AccountSettingsScreen`, and never calls `load()` itself — the assertion (3 bars rendered) only passes if `AccountSettingsScreen.initState`'s unconditional `dashboardCubit.load()` actually fired. `_buildDashboardCubit()` was widened to take an optional `repository` param to support this.

**7. Stale test renamed** — "shows the header titled Configurações and exactly one switch — no other content..." renamed to "shows the biometric toggle and the dashboard chart section", now also asserting `"Sua evolução"` renders.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test test/features/dashboard test/features/account test/core/navigation test/core/di` — all passing.
- Full `fvm flutter test` — **1165/1165 passing** (4 net new tests over the prior 1161).
- `fvm dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed` on all touched files — clean, no changes needed.
